system.description: Armor Class: 5 Hit Dice: 1* Move: 120' (40') Attacks: 1 weapon Damage: By weapon No. Appearing: ld4 (2d24) Save As: E1 Morale: 8 or 10 (see below) Treasure Type: (S + T) E Intelligence: 13 Alignment: Lawful or Neutral XP Value: 6 Monster Type: Demihuman (Rare). Elves can also appear as NPCs. Otherwise, they might be encountered as travelers or wilderness patrols. In hand-to-hand combat, they attack as first level fighters. Each elf will have one 1st level spell (chosen at random).
